title: Module 1 knowledge check
markdown: Two questions about planning a study week.

questions.prompt: How many priorities does this course recommend writing down for the week?
choices: Every task you can think of
None — keep it in your head
One per subject, with no limit

questions.prompt: What should you do when the 25-minute timer ends?
choices: Stop and write one sentence about what is still unfinished
Keep going until the whole list is done
Skip the review for the rest of the week

questions.prompt: The two-minute review asks what you finished and what moves to tomorrow.
